name: Analysis and Design of Algorithms
description: Asymptotic notation; DFS, BFS, and some applications; greedy algorithms: interval scheduling, optimal caching, minimum spanning trees (Prim’s and Kruskal’s ), shortest path, etc.; divide and conquer: sorting, matrix multiplication, etc.; dynamic programming: scheduling, subset sum, etc.; branch and bound, backtracking techniques; network flow algorithms and applications; NP-completeness and reductions; introduction to approximation algorithms; recent trends in algorithms.
